name: 00Widget
summary:
Keep the work you delegate visible after you leave the chat.

00Widget turns updates from AI agents, automations, scripts, and apps into a shared status dashboard on Meta Quest. Arrange it beside your workspace, expand a card for more context, or pop important cards into separate panels so the information you care about stays in view.

See what is running, complete, or waiting for you. Follow progress and ETAs; inspect charts, histories, timelines, breakdowns, lists, and briefings; and run supported actions
